headline: LLM-assisted extraction and curation of biological literature into domain resources
label: Llm Assisted Biological Literature Curation
summary: Recent preprints pair LLM-assisted literature extraction with domain-specific curated resources in toxicology and avian influenza genomics.
synthesis: The dominant thread is LLM-assisted handling of biological literature feeding domain-specific curated resources. AOPTK is an open-source Python toolkit for LLM-assisted retrieval and extraction of chemical-effect relationships from toxicological literature. Roost integrates over 1,300 HPAI publications, surveillance detections and 2,000+ avian genome assemblies in a web resource, using LLM-assisted literature handling. The agent-based modelling paper is a different kind of work: an LLM-assisted bibliometric analysis of knowledge exchange across biological subfields, and it does not describe a curated resource. What is new across these items is the pairing of domain-specific curation with computational assistance, rather than a shared data type or assay format.
